note: The trader's own tokens, laid over the core's (dayz-mcp.toml, [build] tokens: the core's file first, this one second). The core gives the palette and the type of the series; this file adds only what a trade screen has and the PDA does not: the dark bed of an item grid, the tile on it, the strip a panel's title stands on, the colour of a price, the veil under a dialog, the seam around a slot, and two larger sizes for sums.
